updateLocation reads externalId/credentialId from updateEvent results that never return them.

Every uncached article retrieval polls the whole feed since throttling is per URL.

Delete success metric passes name instead of options.Kind in the kind label.
Legacy DeleteCollection duration recorded with recordStorageDuration; also mentions #04 but the anchored fix is #02.
